source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's Chandler campus publishes 169 MW of IT capacity, one third of Arizona's disclosed data center load and the largest single disclosed campus in the state.

Arizona maps 57 data center facilities, but only four publish power figures, and those four total 512 MW. Chandler accounts for 169 MW of that. The published state total is a floor, not a measure of the actual footprint, because most facilities disclose nothing about their load.

The campus covers 2 million square feet of technical space across eight buildings. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, that space holds roughly 4,200 racks; at 10 kW per rack, typical of inference, roughly 16,900. The same footprint can draw very different amounts of power depending on what is installed, so square footage alone says little about demand on the grid.

Certifications cover SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, TIA-942, and Green Globes. They show the campus is qualified to host financial, healthcare, and federal workloads. They do not identify tenants, occupancy, or utilization. No power source, interconnection detail, or announced expansion is published either, so 169 MW is stated capacity rather than measured consumption.
